<ic>To construct the Cinderpath Exchange in Mareholm, Casinea. This is a White Granite ministry and creates the title ‘Cinderpath Benefactor’, to be appointed by vote of the congregation leaders of Highguard once a year. This will be self-funded.<br>
''Proposed by Bastion, Seconded by Miekarova''</ic>
